issues.title: Isolate P9 modules
issues.body:
We're going to strip out P9 modules to focus on the core functionality.  

If/when we support P10 we will restore the components feature by feature, covered by testing.

We'll do this by moving them to a single folder in each package.   We will test the functionality still works in the new packages.

We will then exclude these folders from the build.

We will focus on isolating the large components.  Really small ones that may be re-used across Serge probably don't need to be isolated.

I _don't think_ we need to refactor code from the `helpers` package.

These modules will be moved to a `p9legacy` module under `components/src/local:
- PlanningChannel
- SupportMapping
- SupportPanel
- PlanningAssets
- MapControl
- MapPlanningOrders
- AdjudicationMessagesList
- PlanningMessagesList
    
These types will be moved to a `p9legacy` module under `custom-types`:
- PlanningMessageStructureCore
- PlanningMessageStructure
- InteractionDetails
- PlanningMessage
- MessageAdjudicationOutcomes
- PerForceNarrative
- HealthOutcomes
- LocationOutcomes
- PerceptionOutcomes

These modules will be moved to a `p9legacy` module under `mocks`:
- p9-message-tempaltes-mock
- p9-wargame.mock
- p9b-short-wargame.mock
- p9b-wargame.mock
